LEVEL 1/5 · Grassy Start

LEO-MARIO

5 worlds, 🍄 power-ups, a flying 🦕 Yoshi with a tongue attack, 🐢 Bowser in World 3, and a web-slinging final boss.

🎮 Xbox controller OR ⌨️ keyboard both drive LEO.

📱 Mobile mode auto-rotates to widescreen on phones/tablets. Use ⟲ FLIP if you're on a fixed-orientation device (like a Switch) and it comes up backwards. Switch controllers are auto-detected too.

A/D or ←/→ move · W/↑/Space jump (hold in air on Yoshi to flutter-glide) · F Yoshi tongue attack · ↓/S dismount Yoshi · R restart level

🍄 Every mushroom makes you bigger — keep eating them to grow ridiculously huge (almost screen-height!). Get hit and you shrink one size instead of losing everything. ⭐ Stars make you INVINCIBLE and send you bouncing wildly off the screen edges for a few seconds — anything you touch is toast. ❓ Bump mystery boxes from below for a coin or a mushroom. 🦕 Ride Yoshi, flutter over gaps, flick 🎯 his tongue to eat enemies. Watch for un-stompable spiky enemies and flying ones! Stomp bosses when they're low and vulnerable, or during the final fight, hold E/🎮 Y for unlimited fireballs. (🎮 X = tongue, B = dismount)
